blocks.text:
We've now learned enough to look at a real example. In accordance with an ancient
tradition of computer science, we now introduce Hello World, a la gtkmm:
blocks.zh: 目前我们已经可以自己所学的知识来写一个真正的程序了。根据计算机科学的传统，我们现在以 gtkmm 的方式来介绍 Hello World 程序：

blocks.text: Try to compile and run it before going on. You should see something like this:
blocks.zh: 在继续讲解之前，可以尝试着编译并运行这个程序，你会看到这样的结果：

blocks.text:
Pretty thrilling, eh?  Let's examine the code. First, the
`HelloWorld` class:
blocks.zh: 真让人激动，不是吗？让我们回过头来看一下代码。首先看一下 HelloWorld 类：

blocks.text:
This class implements the "Hello World" window. It's derived from
`Gtk::Window`, and has a single `Gtk::Button` as a member.
We've chosen to use the
constructor to do all of the initialization work for the window,
including setting up the signals. Here it is, with the comments
omitted:
blocks.zh: 这个类实现「Hello World」窗口：派生自 Gtk::Window，有一个 Gtk::Button 成员。我们选择在构造函数里完成窗口的全部初始化工作，包括设置信号。以下是省略注释后的构造函数：

blocks.text:
Notice that we've used an initializer statement to give the `m_button`
object the label "Hello World".
blocks.zh: 注意我们用了初始化列表，把标签「Hello World」交给 m_button 对象。

blocks.text:
Next we call the Button's set_margin() method. This sets
the amount of space around the button.
blocks.zh: 接下来调用 Button 类的 set_margin() 方法。这将设置按钮周围空间的大小。

blocks.text:
We then hook up a signal handler to `m_button`'s `clicked` signal.
This prints our friendly greeting to `stdout`.
blocks.zh: 然后，把 m_button 的 clicked 信号挂接到信号处理函数上。这会向 stdout (标准输出) 打印出友好的问候语。

blocks.text:
Next, we use the Window's set_child() method to put
`m_button` in the Window. The set_child()
method places the Widget in the Window.
blocks.zh: 接下来调用 Windows 类的 set_child() 方法将m_button放入窗口。set_child()方法会将部件放入窗口中。

blocks.text:
Now let's look at our program's `main()` function. Here it is,
without comments:
blocks.zh: 现在让我们来看看程序中没有注释过的 main() 函数：

blocks.text:
First we instantiate an object stored in a `Glib::RefPtr` smartpointer called `app`. This is of type
`Gtk::Application`. Every gtkmm program must have one of these.
blocks.zh: 我们首先实例化一个储存在名为app的RefPtr智能指针对象，它的类型为Gtk::Application 。每一个gtkmm程序都有这样的一个东西。

blocks.text:
Next we call make_window_and_run() which creates an object
of our `HelloWorld` class, shows that Window and starts the gtkmm
*event loop*. During the event loop gtkmm idles, waiting for actions
from the user, and responding appropriately.
When the user closes the Window, make_window_and_run() will return,
causing our `main()` function to return. The application will then finish.
blocks.zh: 接着我们调用make_window_and_run()创建了我们的HelloWorld类对象，显示这个窗口并进入gtkmm消息循环。在消息循环中，gtkmm是空闲的，它等待用户的操作并作出相应的反应。当用户关闭窗口时，run() 函数将返回，导致main()函数的最后一行将被执行。然后程序就结束了。

blocks.text:
Like the simple example we showed earlier, this Hello World program does not use
the command-line parameters.
blocks.zh: 就像我们之前显示的简单示例一样，这个Hello World程序不使用命令行参数。
